name: Wasure-Gasa no Kyouji
source:
At night, he says he hears a crying voice from the umbrella stand.
When Tsugumi, who can talk to things, visits the geta box after school,
Two umbrellas were stuck as if waiting for someone.

[From [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24961]Freem![/url]]
translation:
晚上，他说他听到雨伞架上有哭声。
会说话的津美放学后来到木屐箱时，
两把伞插在了一起，好像在等待着什么人。

[来自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24961]Freem！[/url]]
